question: The Plan for Partition of India is known as the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd June Plan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Mountbatten Plan(1947) or 3rd June Plan:__

__
 
• The failure of the Cabinet Mission was followed by the collapse of the interim Government. 
 
• By the end of 1946 communal violence increased in the country and the British feared that India would settle for a civil war.
 
• Lord Mountbatten replaced Lord Wavell as Viceroy of India in 1947.
 
• Mountbatten's formula was to divide India and at the same time retain the maximum possible unity. 
 
• The actual division between the two new dominions of India and Pakistan was accomplished to be known as the 3rd June Plan.
 
• It was announced at a press conference by Mountbatten on 4 June 1947, and the date of Independence was announced- 15 August 1947.
 
• The main points of the plan were:
 
 
• **Partition**: Muslim-dominated areas may be separated to form a Dominion.
 
 
• Referendum for NWEP and Sylhet: The fate of North-West Frontier Province and Sylhet district of Bengal was to be decided by a referendum.
 
• India would be free by 15 August 1947.
 
• Independence of princely states was ruled out.
 
• A boundary commission to be set up in case of partition.
 
• The Muslim league's demand for a separate state was thus conceded.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wavell plan/Shimla Conference (1945):

 
 
• It was named after the Viceroy of India, Lord Wavell. 
 
• A few proposals in this plan are:
 
 
• With the exception of the Viceroy and Commander in Chief, all the members of the Viceroy's executive council will be Indians.
 
• A kind of interim government was suggested.
 
• Transfer of foreign affairs portfolio from the Governor-General to an Indian member
 
• Congress rejected the Wavell plans because of the actions of the Muslim league.
 
 
 
 
 
• August Offer (1940):
 
 
• On 8th August Lord Linlithgow suggested some measures to get the support of the INC and Muslim League for World War II that is known as August Offer or Linlithgow's offer.
 
• Immediate expansion of the Viceroy Executive Council by including more number of Indians.
 
• A war advisory council
 
• Constitution-making body after the war.
 
• All the constitutional agreements in India must take the consensus of the minority community (veto power to the Muslim League).
 
• Congress rejected the August Offer.
 
 
 
• Poona Pact (1932):
 
 
• It was an agreement between Gandhi and Ambedkar.
 
• Madan Mohan Malviya signed the pact on behalf of Gandhi.
 
• According to this pact:
 
 
• Separate electorates were replaced by the joint electorates for depressed classes.
 
• As against 71 seats announced by MacDonald, this pact reserved 148 seats in the Provincial legislature.
 
• About 18% of the total seats were also reserved for the pressed classes in the central legislature.
